amendment: After engineering smoke produced English for Korean input, added explicit user-selected output language and Korean instructions. No efficacy thresholds changed; first failure retained.
reason: Ground audit in exact input evidence, allow clarification and conservative retention; add portable browser inference.
download_policy: No automatic model download on page open. Explicit model preparation action downloads public weights from Hugging Face/MLC. Engineering smoke may use one model. No paid API or GPU rental.
estimated_download: 0.5B approximately 0.5 GB; 1.5B approximately 1 GB, not exact measured sizes
audit_gate: Every issue requires exact draft substring and exact input-anchor substring. This is provenance validation, not semantic truth verification.
revision_gate: All user-defined terms must remain as literal substrings; model verification must explicitly accept. Otherwise preserve original and display candidate separately.
claim_limit: Does not establish reduced social bias, causal training mechanism, fairness, or an independent critic.
model_revision_limit: Runtime version pinned; upstream prebuilt model URLs may change. Exact model tensor revision is not frozen; record model id and date. Not sufficient for confirmatory reproducibility.
